question: Should OpenClaw add a public reset-start prompt override, and what canonical config path and replacement semantics should it use?
rationale: The affected files are clear, but the request adds a new config surface in an area where repository policy requires a deliberate product/API contract rather than an opportunistic key name.

options.title: Approve Narrow Prompt Override
options.body: Add one canonical full-replacement reset prompt setting with global and per-agent precedence, fallback to the current prompt, and no reset archival or greeting-model behavior in the same change.

options.title: Fold Into Reset Greeting Policy
options.body: Defer this key and resolve it together with the open greeting model/suppression and bare-reset behavior issues so there is one reset-start contract.

options.title: Keep Current Core Surface
options.body: Decline a new core config key for now and rely on existing startup context, reset hooks, and related product work.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Prompt Override
recommendation.body: Add one canonical full-replacement reset prompt setting with global and per-agent precedence, fallback to the current prompt, and no reset archival or greeting-model behavior in the same change.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman authored the current runtime startup-context contract and is the clearest history-backed owner for choosing the next reset-start config shape.
